parsed.explanation: Parent entry screening can refuse visas for sex-document/appearance discrepancy and permits a permanent fraud bar; federal orders ban identity-congruent government facilities and restrict passports; federal prisons and immigration custody show conversion therapy, denial of care, beatings and severe sexual abuse. The division adds a birth-sex public-facility ban, including changing areas and sleeping quarters, a private cause of action, and no state nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage. Absent facts: no criminal presentation law or documented police raids on visitors; some national employment/hate-crime protections and courts remain contested, but functioning institutions enforcing hostile facility/custody policies increase exposure. This is a tier-1 universal institutional exclusion plus severe detention risk, better than organised targeting but worse than mere service friction.
